hotel_name: Hotel Glow Inn-3 Mins Walking From Ndls

positive_snippets: Had a wonderful stay at Hotel Glow Inn. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable. Staff members were polite, cooperative, and always ready to help, which made the stay even better. The location is convenient and peaceful, perfect for both business and family stays. Overall, great value for money with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommended—would definitely stay here again!

Had a fantastic stay at Hotel Glow Inn Paharganj-3 Mins Walk From NDLS Rail Station. The location is perfect—just a 3-minute walk from New Delhi Railway Station. Rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Staff was polite, helpful, and ensured a smooth check-in. Great value for money and highly recommended for anyone visiting Delhi!

I had a great stay at Glow Inn Hotel, located right in the heart of Paharganj, New Delhi. The location is perfect — it’s very easy to commute to different parts of the city and the New Delhi Railway Station is just a short walk away.
The staff here are friendly and helpful, always ready to assist with anything you need. The food is really good, and the service is excellent too. Overall, it’s a comfortable and convenient place to stay for travelers.
negative_snippets:
Pros: Location is 10 min walking to New Delhi station and all restaurants are nearby.
Cons: Non AC room doesnot justify Rs 1400 per day at the condition of the furniture and room. Room No 312 had nearly 50 cockroaches at checkin which was later brought to control through repellent.
Do not be deceived by the colourful photos posted by the property, as reality doesn't go close to that.
Rs 300 was charged for early check-in at 8am instead of 12pm, which is pure business, as we checked out at 7am instead of 12pm and we stayed for less than 24 hours paying additional Rs 300.
Hotel is a lot shabby and so so, but definitely the price doesn't justify the amenities.
